cardObtain: [Unidentified] Defeat this monster in Hollow Zero 1 time to obtain its data
cardQuote: — Outmatched and overpowered, an epic showdown!
cardSkillDesc: During combat, Shining Promise - Billy attacks with powerful motorcycle charges and Starlight Knight flying kicks. A well-timed Defensive Assist can knock him off his bike. After using High-Traction Wheels, he enters an enhanced state and requires two consecutive Defensive Assists to be dismounted.
desc:
A reliable friend, a seasoned fighter, and the very first mentor on the road to combat.
Look! The badge of the shining galaxy is resonating!
Listen! A powerful beat is ringing!
Engines roar, gunfire sparks, and the warm-up is finally over. The Knight hauls in his speaker and joins the battlefield. Are you ready, my friend? It's showtime!
"Just as expected of the Manager! Time to get serious!" "No way, I'm going up against The Champion? For real?"
name: Shining Promise - Billy
